integrity: All enumerators and erasure-failure statements are derived by an explicit finite-geometric proof; two distinct standalone implementations check every 13-column mask. Review is same-model only and not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Complete classification for the thirteen-column full point-line incidence parity-check matrix of PG(2,3), not for arbitrary redundant-check presentations, other planes, or maximum-likelihood decoding. The known minimum stopping distance six is credited as prior; an earlier unindexed exact distribution is possible.
title: Complete stopping configurations and erasure-failure spectrum of the order-three projective plane
